nodes.summary: The binomial family is TP2 (monotone likelihood ratio in the success probability): for `a ≤ a'` and `0 ≤ p ≤ p' ≤ 1`, `Binom(a | n, p') Binom(a' | n, p) ≤ Binom(a' | n, p') Binom(a | n, p)`.
nodes.title: The binomial family is TP2

nodes.summary: The continuous maximum-likelihood CCF `ĉ = min 1 (a / (n κ))` for the allelic-fraction slope `κ = α / (α q + 2 (1 - α))`. Landau et al. (2013) use the grid posterior; this continuous maximizer over `[0, 1]` is derived here.
nodes.title: Maximum-likelihood cancer cell fraction

nodes.summary: For every CCF threshold `t` and posterior level `γ` there is `a₀` such that, for `a ≤ n`, the mutation is called clonal iff `a₀ ≤ a` (`a₀ = n + 1` when no count is called clonal).
nodes.title: The clonal call is a read-count threshold

nodes.summary: Hypotheses on the CCF grid model: purity `0 < α ≤ 1`, copy number `q > 0`, grid in `[0, q]` and within the defining CCF bound `≤ 1`, a nonnegative prior, and one grid point of positive prior weight whose allelic fraction lies strictly inside `(0, 1)` (this makes every posterior well defined).
nodes.title: Grid model for the cancer cell fraction

nodes.summary: Landau et al.'s clonal call: `P(CCF > t | a) > γ` (they take `t = 0.95`, `γ = 0.5`).
nodes.title: Clonal call for a mutation

nodes.summary: For `0 < α ≤ 1`, `q ≥ 1`, `a ≤ n` and `0 < n`, the likelihood `c ↦ Binom(a | n, f(c))` on `[0, 1]` is maximized at `ĉ = min 1 (a / (n κ))`.
nodes.title: The continuous CCF MLE

nodes.summary: The clonal call is upward closed in the read count.
nodes.title: The clonal call is upward closed in the read count

nodes.summary: In a grid model every posterior normalizer `∑_k π_k Binom(a | n, f(grid k))`, `a ≤ n`, is positive.
nodes.title: Positivity of the grid posterior normalizer

nodes.summary: If the kernels `L` (data `x`) and `L'` (data `x'`) satisfy the TP2 inequality `L' i L j ≥ L i L' j` whenever `c j ≤ c i`, then for a nonnegative prior every posterior tail `P(c > t)` is at least as large under `L'` as under `L` (both normalizers positive).
nodes.title: Monotone likelihood ratio implies stochastically larger posteriors

nodes.summary: The CCF posterior is stochastically increasing in the read count (Landau et al. 2013 with the monotone-likelihood-ratio argument): `P(CCF > t | a) ≤ P(CCF > t | a')` for `a ≤ a' ≤ n`.
nodes.title: The CCF posterior is stochastically increasing in the read count

nodes.summary: Landau et al.'s posterior probability that the CCF exceeds `t`, given `a` of `n` reads, purity `α`, copy number `q`, a prior `prior` on the grid points `grid k`: `∑_{grid k > t} π_k Binom(a | n, f(grid k)) / ∑_k π_k Binom(a | n, f(grid k))`, with `f(c) = α c / (α q + 2 (1 - α))`.
nodes.title: Posterior probability that the cancer cell fraction exceeds a threshold

nodes.summary: Posterior probability that the parameter `c i` exceeds `t`, for prior weights `prior` and likelihoods `lik i` of the observed data: `∑_{c i > t} prior i lik i / ∑_i prior i lik i`.
nodes.title: Posterior tail probability on a grid

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
